document_title: Standard Event Budget Templates and Cost Reduction Strategies (Illustrative INR)
disclaimer: All monetary figures and percentages are synthetic illustrative estimates in integer INR, never verified vendor quotes.
cost_saving_rules: Always preserve an 8% to 12% Emergency Reserve when reallocating categories.
Reduce decoration expenses by 20% to 30% using reusable fabric backdrops, warm LED string lights, and seasonal local flowers instead of imported florals.
Choose daytime or weekday venue slots for 15% lower hall rental rates (illustrative estimate).
Use digital RSVP invitations to eliminate printing and courier expenses.
